preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Stored on this computer; not part of the project file
language.label: Language
language.note: Swedish currently covers the interface added in 0.17. The rest of the UI stays in English until the 0.18 translation pass.
preferences.workspace.note: Panel widths and collapsed state are stored on this computer and are not part of the project file.
preferences.layers.title: Layer defaults
preferences.layers.note: Applies to new measurement and drawing layers only. Existing layers keep their colour.
preferences.layers.signalRedDone: Layer colours set to signal red.
preferences.stamps.title: Stamps
preferences.stamps.note: Defaults for new projects. The open project keeps its own preset list in Project settings.
preferences.stamps.fromProject: Use the project's presets as defaults
preferences.stamps.fromProjectTitle: Copy this project's stamp presets into the app defaults.
preferences.stamps.fromProjectDisabled: Open a project to copy its presets.
diagnostics.title: Report a problem
diagnostics.subtitle: Attach the diagnostics to a new GitHub issue
diagnostics.note: GridScalr uploads nothing. The diagnostics contain version, platform and project statistics only — no drawing content, labels or file paths.
welcome.subtitle: Open architectural or engineering drawings as PDF or scanned TIF, calibrate the scale, and measure lengths and areas. Add several sheets to one project. Everything stays on your device.
welcome.demoUnavailable: The demo project is available in the desktop app.
welcome.demoFailed: Could not open the demo project
welcome.step.open: Open a drawing or the demo project.
welcome.step.calibrate: Calibrate the page against a known dimension, or enter the printed scale.
welcome.step.measure: Measure, then review the quantities in View → Quantities.
welcome.footnote: Local-first. Drawings are read from your disk and never uploaded.
launch.nothingMessage: The operating system asked GridScalr to open a file it does not handle. Use a .gridscalr project, a PDF or a TIF drawing.
launch.oneFile: GridScalr opens one file per window and ignored the rest.
preferences.csv.note: Locale follows the app language: Swedish exports use semicolons and decimal commas. Interchange uses commas and dots for scripts and other tools.
